newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates down on surplus funds.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates down on surplus funds.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates traded between five and nine percent amid surplus funds on Tuesday, compared to Monday's 14 percent close, dealer said.
"Most of the day's trading was in the range of five and eight percent but some closing deals were seen at nine percent," one dealer said.
He said the market ended liquid but rates were likely to open higher on Wednesday because of the weekly open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan.
